system.description: This cloak is made of metamaterials with a negative refractive index, so that light actually bends around it, making it and anything it covers invisible (-60 to Perceive, -30 to target with a 50% miss chance in combat). This invisibility works from the microwave to ultraviolet frequencies, but not against radar or x-rays. The drawback is that anything concealed within the cloak can’t see out. This is easily overcome by using external sensor feeds (if available) and entoptics to navigate. Alternatively, a small piece of anti-cloak, which cancels the cloak’s invisibility properties when touched together, can be used to create a small window to peep out of, though this increases the chance of being spotted. Noticing such a window requires a Perceive Test with a -30 modifier.

activatedEffects.description: Metamaterial cloak, makes invisible, ▶218 for blind attacks
